**The epic drawer claims a closed-children count only when one was taken (#1267)** renderChildren in brain/scripts/ui/static/app.js always appended 'closed children are counted above' for an epic, even when epicRollup returned closed:null (pending/disabled lane, failed with no lastCompleteAt, closedRead not ok). Fix: pure rollupNote(rollup) in lib/rollup-model.mjs returns the sentence only when rollup.ok && closed !== null; app.js renders it only when non-null. The #1199 design.md D59/D60/Risks were annotated 'Amended by #1267' to describe closedRead as shipped. Lesson: an empty

passes a text assertion, so a 'no claim' render test must also assert the element is absent.
